dialogue.line: Miranda painted things she saw here.
One of those paintings was of a man in a yellow suit.
I thought he was just like us.
When I found Mom out by the Bottle Tree, I saw him.
Have you ever wondered if maybe this is all just a dream?
That thing I carried inside me... I still feel it.
Part of me feels what he feels.
I think I've seen them before.
I remembered how to hurt them.
This is where the children were sacrificed.
Tell me how we save them when we've already failed!
You want me to help plan a suicide mission because
you think the bones of those children are buried down there!
Yes! There was a hidden door.
Do remember seeing any doors in the basement of Colony House?
You want me to go down in those tunnels!
Then show me the fucking door!
If it's sealed, that's probably for the best.
Our lives are fuckin' weird, man.
You really think now is the best time to...
Well, do you want me to come with you?
What can I do you for?
Hey, do you, uh, mind comin' upstairs and having a word?
Uh, there's something I need to tell everyone.
But it's something that I think
you and Victor need to hear first.
So, I just wanna talk to the two of you; that's all.
I need to say it again?
Sometimes I like to look at his stuff too.
Mom was the one who killed it.
She stabbed it with a voodoo totem.
And how did you know that would work?
There's something I need to tell you both.
that's been very hard for me to...
Mom, whatever it is, just... just say it.
All the way back to the beginning.
The last time I was here, I was Miranda.
Do you have any idea what you just... how dare you?
Maybe you should just sit down.
You don't tell me what to do!
You don't have to listen to this.
All right, why don't we all...
Victor, do you understand everything I said?
No one's claiming that Tabitha is...
when I said she was here before, that she was your mother,
Please stop. I don't want you to talk anymore.
We need to find out about the man in yellow.
What does this have to do with the man in yellow?
it could all be happening again.
If you and Tabitha were here before, does that mean...
Then what the fuck are we all doing here?
These, these children that were sacrificed...
...they have been crying out to Tabitha and me for help,
and that cry, I think on some level,
Can we just pause for a second and talk about the fact
that this is all coming out of a mushroom trip?
I mean, how is this different than any of the insane theories
people have had about this place?
Because of the door in the basement.
Look, Kristi, I was the first person to call bullshit
on all of this, okay, but the truth is,
Jade saw something in that trip
But how do we know this isn't just...
I mean, this place puts a lot of weird shit in our heads.
Believe me, I've thought of that too.
So, how is this any different?
Because of what they did to Jim.
That message on the wall: "Knowledge comes at a cost."
because of what Tabitha and Jade remembered.
Look, that message was meant to scare us.
But I think the message tells us something else.
For the first time, we are close to figuring this place out.
When your enemy threatens you, right,
that means they are scared of you.
And you think this place is scared of us
digging up the bones of these children,
because that could be what gets us home?
Whatever... whatever he said about my wife,
You! Don't you say her name!
Listen to me: saving the children
is the only way to get everyone home.
We are trying to finish what she started!
No! No, you listen to me.
You may think you're helping people.
You may think you're smart enough to get everyone home,
the only thing you will cause is pain.
No matter how fucking smart you think you are.
Julie, I can smell it through the window.
It just... it helps me process things.
After everything you told us last night,
this is what you're gonna hang up on?
Do you want Ethan to see this?
So, is Victor my brother now?
then wouldn't that make me and Victor brothers?
Look, Mom, I know you and Jade think that you've unlocked
this big mystery about this place but...
This place doesn't give us real.
It gives us fucked-up, twisted ideas.
Okay, okay, Julie, listen to me.
If I had any doubt, about anything,
Jade and Boyd wouldn't have told everyone at Colony House.
This is how we could go home!
Mom! I wish people would just stop with that shit.
I need to know you're okay.
But I'm not gonna hurt myself.
I need... I need to find out about the man in yellow.
That means that I have to do something scary.
Will you please come with me?
I'm saying we got one shot at this.
So we need to ask every question we can think of
and then we need to ask them again.
So, beside the three of us, who's been in the tunnels?
We need all the info we can get on the layout.
Uh, map it, sketch it... whatever you need to do.
I don't care. I wanna know every entrance
and every exit to that chamber,
how long we need to dig,
and then we figure out how not to get ourselves killed.
He spent a lot of time on the bus
watching those things come out of the woods at night.
So, we need to get as much intel as we can on their behaviors,
their patterns... at the very least a headcount.
All right, if we're going into the nest,
I wanna know exactly how many we're dealing with. Right.
This place isn't gonna make it easy, you know.
Once we push, it's gonna push back hard.
Yeah. I got an idea about that, so...
Look, we just told everybody out there
The longer they get to stew on it, the greater the chance
somebody gets in their head to do something stupid.
So, we need to do this smart, but we gotta do it fast.
That wasn't just busy work you gave me, huh?
I was hoping you might find something useful
You really think that they've been...
Look, I... We're talking about reincarnation here, okay?
Look, if you're going down into those tunnels,
Yes, I am. And you and me,
we're gonna talk about that when the time comes.
But right now, I need you back in that basement...
You know, this is not just... not just you.
We need a whole team down there.
And we need a second team at the diner in the storerooms.
Anything you can tell me about a man in a yellow suit.
Yeah. I'm hoping something that you find might tell me...
You sure you're not just looking for something
to keep everyone's minds off of how fucking crazy this is?
Listen, if we're gonna do this,
we need to know exactly what is out there waiting for us.
Is that all you can give me?
A man in a yellow suit?
We know that he was here in the late '70s.
As far as any damage, I got the ultrasound from the clinic.
but without a CT or an MRI... yeah,
the hard part is just gonna be getting her to take it easy.
Well, you can go see her.
You should've told me about Jade and Tabitha.
We're supposed to be in this together.
No, yeah. We are. We are.
Still seeing things that aren't there?
No. No, just the one time.
You've got a lot of people's lives in your hands, Boyd.
Maybe you should be the one lying here.
Heard you had a big meeting downstairs.
So you thought it would be a good idea
to gather up a house full of emotionally unstable people
and spend the night talking about reincarnation
and the bones of dead children.
Because you took a fucking sledgehammer to my wall.
That door something we should worry about?
No, we tried to open it; it's sealed.
Jade said it leads to the tunnels,
so we put an extra talisman on it just to be safe.
We need to pick a new spot.
We were pushing it with Jim and the pastor.
Got any more good news you wanna bring me?
I need you to tell me everything you can
about those totems you brought back from the settlement.
The one Tabitha used to kill that doll.
Because tonight I'm gonna find out if they work
on those things that come out of the woods.
Let's say you actually kill one of those things.
Apparently, they don't even stay dead.
You ready to risk another one of our people
going through what Fatima just went through?
What I want is to keep our people safe in those tunnels.
So, let's just deal with one problem at a time.
Okay, so I need three people with Elgin
to go through the storeroom at the diner and then
the rest of you are gonna be in the basement with me.
And, remember, be quick but be thorough, okay?
What are you doing in here?
Did you know anything about him?
Yeah, just about every conversation we had
was about his... his garden back home.
My mom used to tell me that when people die,
She didn't really believe in heaven or hell;
she just believed that death was a transition
to another place we couldn't see from here.
I remember how much comfort that brought me
Whatever they're doing to find those bones, we need to help.
they tend to spread out down the street, right?
And according to Randall, they've got patterns;
some of them have nightly rituals
So, say we catch one of them right here.
Right, we aim fast and dirty, turn around,
head right back into the station.
even if the station is blocked,
we got plenty of exit routes all up and down the street.
'Kay, and what if something goes wrong?
Look, those things are used to us cowering inside our houses,
locking the doors, lowering the blinds,
is for one of us to head straight at them.
The bottom line is, these things can hurt them,
slow them down even. That's gonna make going down
into those tunnels a whole lot safer.
Okay, and who's gonna be the one running out here
I need to talk to you.
Is that the car the man in the yellow suit came here in?
So, what kind of clues are we looking for?
No, honey, I don't think it's a good idea.
We have to go. We have to go right now!
Here, you should see them. Here!
No, he needs to be prepared.
Don't... Did... You came to town last time.
You brought a boy and a girl, and the man in yellow showed up.
Everyone died, but not the boy!
And he grew up alone and afraid.
And now you're here with a boy and a girl again,
and the man in yellow is back.
You have to be prepared, Ethan.
You have to know what's coming.
You need to stop! Stop it! Stop it! Ethan!
Sorry, I didn't mean to bother you.
No, no. No bother at all.
What can I do for you?
I was thinking about what you said earlier this morning.
About... About going down into those tunnels
But it could also be what helps us get home.
Well, we're not quite clear on that yet.
But those things that come out at night,
people... people say that they live in those tunnels.
So, if those bones are important, it's not like
they're just gonna let you go down there and take them.
...it turns out, we might have a new card to play.
Remember this morning when I said that
Tabitha used one of these to kill that doll
what they do to those things that come out of the woods.
Is there a reason we can't just draw a map of the tunnels?
It's a technique I used when I was designing my company.
All right? If you visualize the dimension
of what you're tryin' to create, right,
the space you want to move through,
it helps create a more accurate...
Yeah, we're not exactly designing a company. Right?
You apply the principles of what you know.
Wait! What did you do before you got here?
What did you do? What was your job?
Oh, come on, you know what I did.
Yes. Yes, I know what you did.
Everyone knows what you did, because...
you never shut the fuck up about it.
If I guess, will you tell me if I'm right?
Why... Why are those your first two guesses?
Yeah, we're kind of in the middle of...
Well, don't let me stop you.
What do you think Kenny did before he got here?
Okay. I worked in youth sports.
can we just focus on the maps.
We gotta get you a whistle.
Great, uh, hey, Kenny, can I talk to you outside?
Hey, Henry. What'd you do before you got here?
Pretty much what I'm doing right now.
I'll be there in a second.
Uh, we're just going through some stuff in the storeroom.
Uh, I never got the chance to say
how sorry I was about your dad.
Oh, I know what you mean.
Kristi says it's healing pretty good.
You gonna tell me what happened?
So, I guess you heard about my mom.
And that scares the shit out of me.
or that they've discovered the truth,
But there is a truth here.
I mean, there has to be.
Why can't this whole place just be some
random fucking cruelty that exists for no reason
other than to do exactly what it's doing?
Look, I know you wanna believe that this is all
some part of God's fucked-up plan...
so explain to me why you don't have an eye.
So, part of your test is getting mutilated?
There is a truth behind all of this.
But you know how this place wins?
It's by throwing so many lies at you
that you don't believe the truth
even when it's staring you right in the face.
It isn't right what you're doing, you know.
Yeah, filling people's heads with nonsense.
I mean, telling my son that his mother is...
Have you talked to Tabitha yet?
Have I talked to the woman you claim is a reincarnation
No, I haven't had the chance.
She was out earlier when I stopped by.
You know maybe if you cut down a little on the...
Henry, blink twice if you can hear me.
Hey, Henry. What is it? What just happened?
Let me be the one to go outside.
I just need to make sure that
people are standing by their doors to let me in.
Just in case things go sideways.
I tried to murder a little boy.
Nothing I do will ever be enough.
Well, tonight is your night off.
We go down into those tunnels, that's when I'll need you.
You just make sure you're standing by that door, okay?
Hey. Hey. What are you doing?
Yoga. The fuck does it look like I'm doing?
What are you even doing down here?
working on that project of yours.
Ellis and Kenny are helping Boyd in town.
I can't just fucking lay here anymore.
Donna, if this thing with Jade and Tabitha,
if that's real, after everything you've survived here,
you really wanna die right before we all get to go home
because you were too stubborn to lay in bed for a minute?
You never used to be this sassy.
Yeah, well, I gave birth to a fucking monster, so,
I, um, I heard what Boyd was planning in town
and I would just rather not be down there tonight.
Hey, he tell you the plan?
All right. I talked to everybody in all the houses.
I figure we'll give 'em an hour or so after nightfall.
Make 'em think it's just a normal night.
I should be the one to go out there tonight.
Hey, look, it makes more sense.
Right? I'm your second now, and these are the things
that I'm supposed to do so you don't have to. That's why.
No. I appreciate it, but it's my plan, my risk.
Dad, what if something goes wrong?
We can't afford to lose you here.
Oh, oh, so we can afford to lose Kenny?
That's not what he's saying. You know that.
Listen, we're not having this conversation.
I am not having this conversation!
Dad, you can't fuckin' do it!
Look, it's not safe for you to go out there.
Okay, what happens, what if your leg gives out? Huh?
Like last time? What if you can't get back up this time?
Listen to me very carefully. Both of you, listen!
I'm not sending anyone out there and risk their life
while I sit in here like a...
We've got a few more coming.
if you can't make it back into the station,
you got escape routes up and down the street.
Every house has got somebody waiting at the door for you.
And if you can't make it to one of those houses,
we got talismans on the church, the bus,

Hey, we got one or two more coming up the road.
Yeah, I think we got one.
Still too far. Wait till he's closer.
Okay. Okay, the rest of them are spread out.
It's a good time; let's go!
Don't wait to see what happens.
This isn't going very well, is it?
I think you have a problem, Kenny.
I killed your father, you know.
I know you're still in there!
